principles: advance from B1 connected discourse to sustained B2 argumentation, hypothesis, synthesis and register control
teach the congiuntivo through authentic stance, doubt, evaluation and concession rather than isolated paradigms
develop counterfactual reasoning, nuanced agreement and evidence-based claims in realistic Italian contexts
expand control of passive and impersonal structures, reported discourse and cohesive connectors
keep Persian explanations concise, contrastive and learner-facing while Italian remains idiomatic and independently authored
